evaluator.name: OpenSCAP
evaluator.qualification: available behavior probe only; OpenSCAP advertises OVAL 5.11.1 and fixtures used --skip-validation; not an independent OVAL 5.12.3 proof

records.original_variable_xml:
<ns0:local_variable xmlns:ns0="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-definitions-5" id="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:var:25815500" version="1" datatype="string" comment="audit partition total size in bytes">
          <ns0:arithmetic arithmetic_operation="multiply">
            <ns0:object_component object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.linux:obj:23029400" item_field="block_size" />
            <ns0:object_component object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.linux:obj:23029400" item_field="total_space" />
          </ns0:arithmetic>
        </ns0:local_variable>
records.expected_oval_conversion: Arithmetic computes numeric values (integer/float), then the enclosing Variable declaration requires values to comply with datatype=string. The available evaluator converts the numeric result to its lexical string form; non-numeric components remain arithmetic errors.
records.evaluator_observation: OpenSCAP 1.3.9 with validation skipped evaluated a literal add fixture declared string as true and recorded tested_variable value 3. This is evaluator evidence, not a 5.12.3 qualification.
records.native_preservation: Not preservable by the current native grammar without an explicit numeric-to-string cast or a deliberate source-declaration repair.

pinned_oval_evidence.xsd: oval-definitions-schema.xsd VariableType documentation around line 534; function-specific documentation/arithmetic Schematron around lines 731-740, split 845-860, count 955-960.
pinned_oval_evidence.schematron: The pinned Schematron restricts arithmetic components to int/float and split components to string, but does not assert that local_variable @datatype equals a function result datatype. XML Schema/Schematron acceptance therefore does not prove evaluator conversion.
